title: RouteGraph-Mona: Confusion-Aware Routing Fine-Tuning for Mineral Image Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.02282v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mineral image classification is important for geological exploration and resource development, but it remains challenging due to substantial intra-class variations in appearance and high inter-class visual similarity. Multi-cognitive Visual Adapter (Mona) is a vision-oriented parameter-efficient adapter that adapts pre-trained visual models by tuning only a few parameters. However, Mona statically aggregates responses from multiple scales, limiting its ability to accommodate sample-specific scale preferences and model confusion among visually similar mineral categories. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{RouteGraph-Mona}, a lightweight route-space regularization method built on Mona. Specifically, we replace Mona's static multi-scale aggregation with sample-adaptive routing. translated_title: RouteGraph-Mona：面向矿物图像分类的混淆感知路由微调方法
translated_abstract: 矿物图像分类对地质勘探和资源开发具有重要意义，但由于类内外观差异显著以及类间视觉相似度高，该任务仍然具有挑战性。多认知视觉适配器是一种面向视觉的参数高效适配器，仅需微调少量参数即可适配预训练视觉模型。然而，Mona 采用静态方式聚合来自多个尺度的响应，限制了其适应样本特定尺度偏好以及对视觉相似矿物类别之间混淆进行建模的能力。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 RouteGraph-Mona，一种构建在 Mona 之上的轻量级路由空间正则化方法。具体而言，我们用样本自适应路由替换了 Mona 的静态多尺度聚合。由此产生的分支选择行为定义了一个紧凑的路由空间，能够捕捉每张图像的尺度偏好。随后，我们对该路由空间进行正则化（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出 RouteGraph-Mona，通过样本自适应路由替换静态多尺度聚合并引入路由空间正则化，有效缓解矿物图像分类中视觉相似类别间的混淆问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes RouteGraph-Mona, which replaces Mona's static multi-scale aggregation with sample-adaptive routing and applies route-space regularization to mitigate confusion among visually similar mineral categories.
